subject: Cloud Computing
title: The Future of Cloud Competition
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Future of Cloud Competition.

hook.text: AI is reshaping cloud competition. The provider with the most GPU capacity wins the next decade.

buildup.text: Microsoft leads with OpenAI integration. Google has Gemini. AWS has Bedrock. Each bets on different AI strategies.

discovery.text: Specialized AI cloud startups like CoreWeave are growing by focusing purely on GPU compute.

twist.text: The next cloud giant might not sell general infrastructure at all. It might sell AI as a service.

climax.text: Cloud competition is intensifying, not settling. AI has reopened the race in ways nobody expected.

punchline.text: The cloud war isn't over. AI just changed the battlefield.

quiz.question: How is AI reshaping cloud competition?
options: Demand for GPU compute is creating new competitive advantages and even new cloud companies
AI has made all cloud providers identical in their offerings
AI reduced the need for cloud computing entirely

details.summary: Cloud competition is evolving from raw infrastructure toward AI services, edge computing, and industry-specific solutions. The next competitive battleground will be who provides the best AI platforms, the most comprehensive edge presence, and the deepest industry expertise.
details.whyItMatters: The future of cloud competition determines which services will be available, at what cost, and with what degree of lock-in. Competition drives innovation that benefits every cloud customer.
takeaways: AI platforms are the next major competitive battleground
Edge computing opens competition beyond centralized data centers
Industry-specific cloud solutions enable deeper differentiation

faq.question: Will the big three maintain dominance?
faq.answer: In traditional cloud infrastructure, likely yes due to economies of scale. However, edge computing, AI-specialized platforms, and industry-specific clouds create opportunities for new competitors. Cloudflare, Oracle, and specialized AI startups are already carving out significant niches.

faq.question: How will AI reshape cloud competition?
faq.answer: The provider with the best AI models, most GPU capacity, and easiest AI development experience will attract the fastest-growing workloads. Microsoft's OpenAI partnership, Google's TPUs and Gemini, and AWS's custom chips each represent different competitive strategies.
